invariants: Dashboard does not create a second project or commercial source of truth
Revenue is confirmed only from authoritative paid-order evidence
Margin is confirmed only when cost inputs are current and sufficiently complete
Pipeline stage must reflect authoritative lead/commercial state rather than inferred website behaviour
Capacity status must consume governed capacity evidence and cannot invent availability
Customer health must not equate absence of complaints with satisfaction
Recurring revenue is confirmed only for active customer-accepted support or maintenance commitments
Missing, stale or contradictory evidence renders REVIEW or HOLD
Every executive metric must expose source status, freshness and evidence completeness
Dashboard cannot send customer outreach, change price, approve quotation, charge payment, alter scope, merge code or deploy Production
